profile.headline: Focused on adding value for my customers and ensuring that our partnership is as rewarding and enjoyable as it is productive.
profile.summary: I have experience working on many of the largest cloud computing systems in the world and hope to continue to work with talented people on challenging problems.

positions.title: DBA
positions.description:
o Responsible for hiring 3 of the 5 DBAs currently working at Dropbox.
o DRI on automated database compares.
o Assisted in rollout process of GTIDS on N thousand databases.
o Improved, automated, and documented many repetitive and/or complicated tasks.
o Frequently troubleshooting and identifying database issues.
o Repeat presenter at Percona Live.
o Created dashboard for monitoring top N metrics for our database clusters.

positions.title: Operational DBA
positions.description:
o One of a team of DBAs supporting President Barack Obama's Website during the 2012 election campaign. Primary DBA for Zendesk and Discoverbooks.
o Primary DBA for a sharded mysql database system growing N gigabytes per day. 
o Primary DBA for multiple clients with various forks of MySQL and releases of Linux: MariaDB, PerconaDB, MySQL, Redhat, Centos, Ubuntu, etc.
o Assisting our team in developing a standard process for Database performance reviews.
o Managing various types of backup and restores: LVM snapshots, MySQL dump and import, Xtrabackup, and Holland backups.
o Troubleshooting problem systems and queries. 
o Using bash and python in combination with sed, awk, and various other unix utilities to support automation and admininistration of various tasks.

positions.title: DBA
positions.description:
o Troubleshot database performance and replication issues on a daily basis for N thousand instances.
o Wrote automation scripts for various tasks using bash, perl, php, and python.
o Author of dgen.php, a script that generates my.cnfs for N thousand instances based on local host configurations and db meta data.
o Primary DBA responsible for hundreds of central databases at Facebook.
o Also drove the upgrade of the central databases from 5.0 to 5.1.X
o One of many DBAs responsible for the management of N thousand customer facing MySQL databases. Many databases > N terabytes.
o Often troubleshot networking issues with network engineering and ensured timely restores.
o Prior to leaving almost finished the modification of innobackupex, an open source perl script, to support symbolic links for multiple storage types.
o Wrote numerous scripts in python to support partitioning, monitoring, and other tasks.
o Assisted in numerous database recoveries and several that spanned thousands of instances.
o Reviewed peer bash, perl, php, and python code.

positions.title: Database Architect/SRDBA
positions.description:
o RMAN
o Backup and Recovery
o Replication
o Dataguard
o ZFS
o Helped architect and manage Domino's first online ordering database.
o Managed over 250 Oracle and MySQL instances.
o Assisted in the support and architecture of a sharded MySQL personal data store.

positions.title: Database SRDBA
positions.description:
o RMAN
o Backup and Recovery
o Replication
o Dataguard

positions.title: SRDBA
positions.description: I was one of the DBAs responsible for management of Oracle and MySQL databases.

positions.title: DBA
positions.description:
o Secondary DBA for Oracle Parallel Server.
o Managed Yellow's primary account cost management database.
o Responsible for Oracle enterprise wide backup and recovery strategy.
o Responsible for various monitoring and maintenance scripts written in sh and ksh.
